name: Master Style Public Company Limited
summary: Master Style Public Company Limited operates a comprehensive cosmetic surgery facility in Thailand, known as Masterpiece Hospital. This institution offers a broad spectrum of aesthetic procedures, including nasal reshaping (rhinoplasty), eyebrow lifts, facial contouring, breast enhancement or reduction surgeries, body sculpting through liposuction, eye operations, and facial reconstruction. Furthermore, its services extend to hair transplantation and other hair restoration treatments, as well as advanced skincare and laser therapies. The company was founded in 2012 and maintains its primary base of operations in Dusit, Thailand.
